slug: 2025-06-12 Rwanda hits 38% internet penetration, but cost still keeps millions offline

facts.fact: TechCabal reports, citing new International Telecommunication Union data, that 38% of Rwanda's population is online as of mid-2025 (5.5 million internet users of an estimated 14.4 million people); no age range is given.
TechCabal reports the ITU-sourced share of Rwanda's population online was 34% in 2024, before rising to 38%; no age range is given.

systems.country_label: Internet usage 57% urban and 19% rural (EICV7, National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda); group figures, no national total
systems.owner: National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda

systems.country_label: Ministry of ICT official: internet penetration infrastructure has grown to 62% (infrastructure, not people using)
